entries.subject: DAMIT 204: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 204, version 2008-02-21, pole (322°, 18°), period 4.701204 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 162 ± 17 km, volume-equivalent diameter DAMIT lists for this size-calibrated model. DAMIT marks the model as size-calibrated and lists an equivalent diameter of 162 ± 17 km with it; the model references describe the scaling.

entries.subject: Resolved surface imagery
entries.finding: No spacecraft or resolved ground-based image of this asteroid was found in the archives searched for this package.
entries.revisitWhen: A resolved image or a registered surface map of this asteroid is published.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "81 km (size-calibrated model)" (damit-models) implies a diameter of 162 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 211, DAMIT model 204 diameter 149 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 204 fitted to 3 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Dembowska whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 31 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.803 at 462 nm, 1.108 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#b0a593 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 38.4% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 2.5%), from the IRAS Minor Planet Survey (PDS data set IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
